entities.summary: Ion Alexe is a retired heavyweight boxer from Romania. He competed at the 1968 and 1972 Olympics and won a silver medal in 1972, losing to Teófilo Stevenson by walkover after he was medically disqualified to contest the final. Alexe won the European title in 1969 and placed third in 1973. Domestically he won six Romanian heavyweight titles. Ion Alexe was a athletes & competitors from Cornu (b. 1946-07-25, Cornu). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
